title: Sordland/Turn02/A_ReformBriefing
description: Lucian Galade approaches the president and explains why the reforms are a necessary step.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. President, I've heard from Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, I've heard from Mr. Galade that you're not intending to support the democratic reforms."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""There is a lot to talk about the f..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is a lot to talk about the future of this process. Let us begin to tackle the points of contention."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The reforms were slowly becoming th..."
entries.dialogueText: The reforms were slowly becoming the most significant expectation of my government. We would be changing Soll's Constitution of '29.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I came a little early to the meetin..."
entries.dialogueText: I came a little early to the meeting room before anybody showed up. We had scheduled a meeting to discuss the progress of the reform committee regarding the new Constitution.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Most people nowadays blamed the con..."
entries.dialogueText: Most people nowadays blamed the constitution for the outstanding problems of the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On the other hand, the reformists i..."
entries.dialogueText: On the other hand, the reformists in the Assembly had been getting louder about their demands. What I knew for sure was that I needed to do something about this encroaching chaos before it swallowed me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Meanwhile, Lucian, Petr and Nia had..."
entries.dialogueText: Meanwhile, Lucian, Petr and Nia had been leading the committee to prepare an initial draft for the constitutional amendments. I was intrigued to hear their results.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "There was a knock on the door. It w..."
entries.dialogueText: There was a knock on the door. It was Lucian.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Good afternoon, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian arrived exactly on the hour..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian arrived exactly on the hour mark again. His punctuality could almost be described as obsessive.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Are you waiting behind the door to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Are you waiting behind the door to come at the exact right second?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good afternoon, Lucian.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good afternoon, Lucian."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sorry, sir?""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, sir?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Forget it. How are you, today?""
entries.dialogueText: "Forget it. How are you, today?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You seem to be arriving at the exa..."
entries.dialogueText: "You seem to be arriving at the exact second all our meetings start."
entries.menuText: "You seem to be arriving at the exact second all our meetings start."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Punctuality is important for me, s..."
entries.dialogueText: "Punctuality is important for me, sir. I'm just doing my job."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm good, Mr. President. Thanks fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm good, Mr. President. Thanks for asking."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We should begin the meeting as soo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should begin the meeting as soon as Mrs. Morgna and Vice President Vectern arrive. We finally have some results from the reform committee."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took a seat on the table and too..."
entries.dialogueText: He took a seat on the table and took out a bunch of documents, spreading them on the long table.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How does it look?""
entries.dialogueText: "How does it look?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What results?""
entries.dialogueText: "What results?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Good."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, the situation is quite compl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, the situation is quite complicated. But I'm sure we will make it work, just like we accomplished many things before."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The reform committee already draft..."
entries.dialogueText: "The reform committee already drafted the amendments for the new Constitution thanks to the help of the members."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But the situation is still quite c..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the situation is still quite complicated politically. We'll go over the details in the meeting."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll go over the details regardin..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll go over the details regarding the new constitution in the meeting."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few minutes later, Petr and Nia a..."
entries.dialogueText: A few minutes later, Petr and Nia also arrived.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a short chat, everybody sat d..."
entries.dialogueText: After a short chat, everybody sat down and took out their notes. I knew it was going to be a long meeting.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Our committee meetings have been r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our committee meetings have been really fruitful, and we already started on the constitutional draft together with the feedback from all the political parties."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We are making clear progress here...."
entries.dialogueText: "We are making clear progress here. You wouldn't really block our hard work, would you?"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. President, our committee meeti..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President, our committee meetings were really fruitful, and we already started working on the constitutional draft together with the reformists."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""They demanded a little too much, b..."
entries.dialogueText: "They demanded a little too much, but we've had success with Frens Ricter to create a realistic draft that could potentially go through the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's that supposed to mean?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's that supposed to mean?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I've already explained my intentio..."
entries.dialogueText: "I've already explained my intentions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A final decision hasn't been made..."
entries.dialogueText: "A final decision hasn't been made yet."
entries.menuText: "A final decision hasn't been made yet."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""A *little*? They demanded to rewri..."
entries.dialogueText: "A *little*? They demanded to rewrite the whole Constitution!"

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I also didn't like their theatrics..."
entries.dialogueText: "I also didn't like their theatrics but the requests were definitely not outrageous. They were just not realistic in today's political circumstances."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I would.""
entries.dialogueText: "I would."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""This is our once in a lifetime cha..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is our once in a lifetime chance to change the Constitution of Tarquin Soll, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You campaigned to bring real democ..."
entries.dialogueText: "You campaigned to bring real democracy to Sordland."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We worked hard to create a draft t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We worked hard to create a draft together with the leaders of our party and the opposition. Nothing else is more important for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""With all due respect, you should h..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, you should hold that promise you made to the Sordish people."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""With all due respect, I'll be the..."
entries.dialogueText: "With all due respect, I'll be the judge of that."
entries.menuText: "With all due respect, I'll be the judge of that."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for the advice, Mrs. Morgna.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the advice, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll see what we can do.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll see what we can do."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If I may continue, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "If I may continue, Mr. President. We've discussed the possibilities of your intentions with Mr. Galade."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr cut in before Nia could speak."
entries.dialogueText: Petr cut in before Nia could speak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She leaned slightly towards me."
entries.dialogueText: She leaned slightly towards me.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I took a seat on the centre chair i..."
entries.dialogueText: I took a seat on the centre chair in the vacant meeting room as I waited for them to show up.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think this was yet another fruit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this was yet another fruitful meeting, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But now we have a better picture o..."
entries.dialogueText: "But now we have a better picture of your intentions, sir. I will start reaching out to my contacts to make a draft that works for you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll present your input to the USP..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll present your input to the USP leaders and the National Front. In a few months, you would have the draft on your desk to make the final changes yourself."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think this was yet another fruit..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this was yet another fruitful meeting, sir. I trust your judgement."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your service is appreciated.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your service is appreciated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If we do this, I promise, you will..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we do this, I promise, you will be kings."
entries.menuText: "If we do this, I promise, you will be kings."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Together we will make Sordland gre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together we will make Sordland great."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for the meeting, gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the meeting, gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you for your time, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your time, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes we will!""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes we will!"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you for the kind words, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the kind words, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You can count on us, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can count on us, Anton."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm sure you will lead us to great..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you will lead us to greatness, sir. Thanks for your time."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Thank you, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Anton."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your service is appreciated.""
entries.dialogueText: "Your service is appreciated."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""If we do this, we will be remember..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we do this, we will be remembered as heroes."
entries.menuText: "If we do this, we will be remembered as heroes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Together we will democratize Sordl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Together we will democratize Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Thanks for the meeting, everybody.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thanks for the meeting, everybody."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you for the kind words, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for the kind words, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Thank you, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you, Anton."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Thank you for your time, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your time, sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You can count on us, Anton.""
entries.dialogueText: "You can count on us, Anton."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""And you have my full support, Mr...."
entries.dialogueText: "And you have my full support, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes! The Heroes of Sordland!""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes! The Heroes of Sordland!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He laughed."
entries.dialogueText: He laughed.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""You have my support, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have my support, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, sir. Thank you for your time.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, sir. Thank you for your time."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Ours too, of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ours too, of course."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Yes, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think this is where we'll call i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this is where we'll call it, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Have a good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good day."

entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think this is where we'll call i..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think this is where we'll call it, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Have a good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the room."
entries.dialogueText: They left the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the room."
entries.dialogueText: They left the room.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""So, sir, are we scheduling a meeti..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, sir, are we scheduling a meeting with Chief Justice Orso Hawker?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes. Set up a meeting with Orso Ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Set up a meeting with Orso Hawker. We need the Old Guards."
entries.menuText: "Yes. Set up a meeting with Orso Hawker. We need the Old Guards."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. Let him come to me. I am sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. Let him come to me. I am sure he will come begging."
entries.menuText: "No. Let him come to me. I am sure he will come begging."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes... sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes... sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes sir."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We will keep the reform committee..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will keep the reform committee working in the meantime so that it doesn't look like we are completely shutting everything down."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, that's important. If we can't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, that's important. If we can't cooperate with the Old Guards, we could always return to the table."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I think we should get to work, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "I think we should get to work, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian grabbed his notes and carefu..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian grabbed his notes and carefully placed them in his briefcase.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes. Thanks for the meeting.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Thanks for the meeting."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Have a good day.""
entries.dialogueText: "Have a good day."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They left the room."
entries.dialogueText: They left the room.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Mr. Ricter's deputy even suggested..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter's deputy even suggested removing the term 'Sord' from the constitution completely."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Nonetheless, Mr. Vice President, t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Nonetheless, Mr. Vice President, thanks for your convincing arguments we seem to have reached a common ground already."
